name: Mediarium
description: Movies, TV, music and books from search to library in one app

paths.name: Config
paths.description: Mediarium's database, settings, API key and logs. Back it up.

paths.name: Cache
paths.description: Your MOS storage at the same path, so Mediarium can download into /mnt/cache/downloads and move files into your library without copying.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: Mediarium web app and API, published on host as 6882

ports.name: Port 6883
ports.description: Torrent connections from other peers (TCP and UDP), published on host as 6883. Set Mediarium's torrent Listen port to 6883 to use it.

ports.name: Port 6883
ports.description: Torrent connections from other peers (TCP and UDP), published on host as 6883. Set Mediarium's torrent Listen port to 6883 to use it.

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: The user id that owns the app's files. 500 is the MOS default.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: The group id that owns the app's files. 500 is the MOS default.

variables.name: DOWNLOADS_DIR
variables.description: Where downloads go while they finish. Keep it under /mnt/cache, on the same disk as your library, so finished files move in at once.

variables.name: TV_DIR
variables.description: Your TV show library folder, like /mnt/cache/media/TV.
